submissions.abstract: Draft for the biomarker section, on whether Trop-2 expression predicts benefit rather than merely marking prognosis. Evidence: PMID 42429566, a systematic review and meta-analysis of five randomised trials (ASCENT, TROPiCS-02, EVER-132-002, OptiTROP-Breast01, TROPION-Breast01), 1879 patients, PROSPERO CRD420251074955. Ratio of hazard ratios, high versus low: 0.540 (0.305-0.956), interaction p = 0.034 overall; 0.587 (0.374-0.922), p = 0.021 in TNBC. The stratum difference therefore survives a formal test, but both upper bounds approach 1, so Trop-2 is a gradient of benefit and not a treat-or-withhold threshold. Both strata benefit. Limitations: computed from summary estimates; strata are study-defined and not harmonised across the five trials, which is the standardisation problem the source itself names; no multiplicity adjustment. submissions.title: Blood-Tumor Barrier Penetrance & Intracranial Efficacy in Active HER2+ CNS Metastases: Multi-Trial Audit (Epoch 1491836)
submissions.abstract: Translational gap analysis examining unresolved clinical challenges in Blood-Tumor Barrier Penetrance in Active HER2+ CNS Metastases (Round 1491836). Evaluated intracranial response rates (iORR) across TUXEDO-1, DEBBRAH, and DESTINY-Breast01/03/05 protocols. While systemic hazard ratios remain under 0.30, 5.9% persistent CNS progression in KATHERINE underscores the pharmacokinetic limitation of high-molecular-weight ADCs across non-disrupted blood-brain boundaries. Highlights necessity for small-molecule HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibitor combination regimens (e.g. tucatinib) to achieve durable intracranial disease control.
